description:
We're a team of Industrial Design students from Capital University (CU), Egypt, on a mission to bring forgotten NASA space equipment back into the spotlight.

Through creativity and interactive design, we're turning forgotten machines into stories worth exploring. Because every space explorer has a story to tell!

We may not be astronauts, but we're ready to explore the stories left behind!
summary:
Welcome to Beyond Their Mission! For NASA’s Abandoned but Not Forgotten Challenge, we created an interactive journey to rediscover the stories of space equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars.

Through a digital platform and a physical projector, users can explore NASA's machines, rovers, and scientific instruments, discover their missions, understand their purposes, and learn about the discoveries they made.

The experience includes a voice assistant that lets users interact with the projector through voice commands, ask questions, and explore information. A dedicated mobile app also allows users to control the projector and navigate the experience directly from their devices.

For younger explorers, Kids Mode transforms learning into a fun adventure with colorful visuals, simple explanations, and interactive activities.

Beyond Their Mission brings forgotten space history to life, proving that even when a mission ends, its story and discoveries live on.
details:
Beyond Their Mission

NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

Project Overview

Beyond Their Mission is an interactive educational project that brings attention to abandoned, inactive, and decommissioned space missions, spacecraft, and satellites. It aims to preserve their stories, discoveries, and scientific contributions through a digital and physical experience.

How Does It Work?

Our project consists of three main components:

  1. Interactive Landing Page Website

An engaging website that introduces users to forgotten space missions. Visitors can explore spacecraft, discover mission histories, learn about their objectives and achievements, and understand what happened after their missions ended.

  1. Projector Control Application

A dedicated application that allows users to control the projector and navigate through displayed educational content, creating an interactive and immersive learning experience.

  1. Physical Projector Design

A 3D model of the projector, designed to represent the physical product and connect its appearance with the digital experience.

Benefits and Intended Impact

The project aims to preserve space history, promote scientific awareness, and make complex information accessible to different audiences. It supports education and research while inspiring children, students, and space enthusiasts to explore science and technology.

Our goal is to transform overlooked space missions into engaging educational experiences and show that their contributions remain valuable even after their missions end.

Tools and Software

  • Figma: UI/UX design, interactive website design, projector control application, and prototyping.
  • Autodesk 3ds Max: 3D modeling and visualization of the physical projector.
  • Canva: Creating visual materials and presentation designs.

Creativity and Innovation

The creativity of Beyond Their Mission lies in combining digital storytelling, interactive interfaces, and physical product design. The website provides an accessible way to explore forgotten space missions, while the projector application creates a shared visual learning experience. The 3D-designed projector connects the digital interfaces with a physical product.

Factors Considered by Our Team

During development, we considered user experience, accessibility, visual communication, educational value, information accuracy, interactivity, physical design, technical feasibility, and the needs of different audiences, including children, students, and researchers.

Our Vision

We believe that a space mission does not lose its value when it ends. Every spacecraft has a story, every mission has a purpose, and every discovery leaves something behind.

Beyond Their Mission aims to preserve these stories and inspire people to explore what remains beyond the end of a mission.

Their missions may have ended, but their contributions are far from over.
